We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts.

Facts: Liu bought disabled persons' personal info (25,751 records) and phone, bank cards etc. Then used info to call victims, pretended to be civil affairs bureau staff, defrauded them of 302,840 yuan transferred to accounts. So crimes: fraud (诈骗) – specifically contract fraud? It's fraud by deception, not contract. So "诈骗罪". Also illegal acquisition of personal information – violation of personal information security law, but criminal charge: "非法获取公民个人信息罪" maybe "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (illegal acquisition of personal information). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (Article 285 of Criminal Law). Also possibly "非法提供公民个人信息罪" but here they obtained and used. So two charges: 诈骗罪;非法获取公民个人信息罪.

The prompt says: "其又以其他方式非法获取公民个人信息，情节严重，其行为应当以××追究其刑事责任". So indeed second charge is illegal acquisition of personal information.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗;非法获取公民个人信息罪<eoa>
